content.short: Odyssey is a DeFi hub for discovering trading, prediction-market and yield opportunities.
content.description: Odyssey is a DeFi discovery app where users explore opportunities across trading, prediction markets and yield strategies, including Pendle strategies, and track them from a single portfolio page. DefiLlama tracks Odyssey on Plasma.
